run_mvsanywhere_on_scene: run MVSAnywhere depth estimation on a single scene and store predicted depth outputs
load_model: load an MVSAnywhere inference model from a repository path and checkpoint onto a device
get_mvsa_options: get and configure MVSAnywhere options from YAML config files and command line arguments
prepare_dataset_options: prepare dataset options by creating temporary directories and computing frame tuples for a scan
to_gpu: move tensors in a dictionary to the GPU while ignoring specified keys
